name: Lake Causeway
title: Lake Causeway
description: Lake Causeway is a complete causeway blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. The design calls for 1500 ft causeway with 24 ft roadway and 4 ft freeboard, built from Compacted earth embankment with geotextile. Equalizer culverts every 300 ft for water flow. Overtopping designed for storm surge. The plan sheets include embankment cross-section sheets, culvert layout and details, and armor and paving plans. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices. Signature-line original design by the JAH system; verify against local codes before building.
dimensions: 1500 ft causeway with 24 ft roadway and 4 ft freeboard
structural_notes: Equalizer culverts every 300 ft for water flow. Overtopping designed for storm surge.
